newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT.

text.p: Pakistan captain Wasim Akram elected to bat after winning the toss in the World Series limited overs match against Australia at Adelaide Oval on Sunday.
Australia beat West Indies in the opening two matches in the triangular tournament.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Greg Blewett, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Tom Moody, Ian Healy, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Glenn McGrath, Jason Gillespie 12th man.

Pakistan - Aamir Sohail, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmed, Mohammad Wasim, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Moin Khan, Shahid Afridi, Saqlain Mushtaq, Wasim Akram (captain), Waqar Younis, Mushtaq Ahmed, Shahid Nazir (12th man)
